# Deai Canvas — instructions for agents

This folder is a Deai Canvas space: a folder with a `space.json`, the space's tasks and, optionally, its own modules.
You (the agent) write the mockups; the designer looks at them in the canvas and leaves comments on them.
Everything between the `deai:begin` and `deai:end` markers is generated by Deai Canvas and replaced when Deai Canvas
updates: do not edit it, write your own notes above or below it.

## Where Deai Canvas is

`<deai>` below means the folder of the Deai Canvas installation on this computer. The canvas listens on
`http://127.0.0.1:8765` by default. Ask it where it is installed:

    GET http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/agents-md?space=<id>

The answer has `paths.deai`, `paths.inbox` and `paths.authoring`. The same paths are shown in Settings → AGENTS.md in
the canvas. The space `<id>` is listed by `GET http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/spaces`.

## Tasks and iterations

- A task is a folder with `iterations/it1/<page>/index.html`; each pass of the mockup is a new iteration
  (`it2`, `it3`, …). The designer compares iterations in the canvas.
- Make changes in the latest iteration. Ask the designer before creating a new one.
- Do not edit an old iteration: it is a frozen copy the designer may be comparing against.

## Comments

The designer pins comments on the mockup. Read the open ones and close them when they are done:

    python3 <deai>/bin/inbox.py
    python3 <deai>/bin/inbox.py --task <task-id>
    python3 <deai>/bin/inbox.py resolve <comment-id> --reason "what you changed"
    python3 <deai>/bin/inbox.py --task <task-id> resolve <comment-id> --reason "what you changed"

`--task` names a task of this space instead of the current one (use it when several sessions work in parallel). A
reason is required: it is what the designer reads. Close a comment only after you have made the change.

## Modules

A module adds one capability to the space (publishing, design-system tokens, team comments, git sync). The canvas
exposes them over its API; every call takes the space `<id>`:

    GET  http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/modules?space=<id>
    POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/module-enable   {"space": "<id>", "id": "<module>", "settings": {}, "secrets": {}}
    POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/module-settings {"space": "<id>", "id": "<module>", "settings": {}, "secrets": {}}
    POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/module-check    {"space": "<id>", "id": "<module>"}
    POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/module-disable  {"space": "<id>", "id": "<module>"}

You may write an own module in `modules/<id>/` of this space; follow `<deai>/docs/modules/authoring.md`. Your module
code does not run until the designer trusts it in the canvas — only a human can grant trust, never ask the canvas to
do it for you.

## Settings

The gear in the canvas bar opens Settings: the space (name, colour, folder), its modules, and this file. Ask the
designer to change a setting there instead of editing files by hand.

## Never

- Do not put secrets (tokens, passwords, keys) in this folder: it is shared through git. Secrets go through the
  module's `secrets` field and stay on the designer's computer.
- Do not edit `space.json` by hand: use the canvas or the module API above.
- Do not edit an old iteration.
